title: HMGB1 B-box domain self-complexes promote protein-polyelectrolyte interactions
authors: Kagelmacher M; Pigaleva M; Zarate R; Bechtella L; Pagel K; Koksch B; Dernedde J; Hermann A; Risse T
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HMGB1 B-box结构域自组装增强与肝素等多阴离子静电互作，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-核酸样多聚电解质互作及AlphaFold建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究。
abstract: HMGB1, a nuclear DNA-binding protein, can be secreted by activated immune cells or passively released from damaged cells. In such cases, HMGB1 functions as an alarmin that activates the immune system. Excessive inflammation may lead to pathogenesis, whereas this response can be dampened by polyanion binding, which impedes further receptor recognition. Moreover, HMGB1 is known to form liquid droplets in the cellular environment—a phase separation directly linked to its proper function. While the A-Box domain is believed to be primarily responsible for heparin binding due to its conserved binding site, the association and phase separation behavior of HMGB1 may be mediated by the B-box domain, owing to its extended hydrophobic regions. In this study, we first demonstrated that the B-box protein forms 30-nm large self-associates while maintaining its structure. Next, using molecularly sensitive EPR spectroscopy, we showed that the presence of these protein associations significantly enhances interactions with heparin. Notably, the local conformational changes induced by heparin are similar in both individual protein chains and their self-associated forms. To explain this effect, AlphaFold modeling was employed, revealing that the formation of protein multimers induces charge redistribution, resulting in an extended positively charged region that enhances electrostatic attraction to negatively charged polyanions, such as heparin.
abstract_zh: HMGB1是一种核DNA结合蛋白，可由活化的免疫细胞分泌或从受损细胞中被动释放。在此类情况下，HMGB1作为警报素（alarmin）发挥作用，激活免疫系统。过度炎症可能导致病理发生，而这一反应可通过多阴离子结合被抑制，从而阻碍进一步的受体识别。此外，已知HMGB1在细胞环境中形成液滴——这是一种与其正常功能直接相关的相分离（phase separation）现象。尽管A-Box结构域因其保守的结合位点被认为主要负责肝素结合，但HMGB1的缔合和相分离行为可能由B-box结构域介导，这归因于其延伸的疏水区域。在本研究中，我们首先证明了B-box蛋白在保持其结构的同时形成30纳米大小的自缔合物。接下来，利用分子敏感的电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱，我们表明这些蛋白缔合物的存在显著增强了与肝素的相互作用。值得注意的是，由肝素诱导的局部构象变化在单个蛋白链及其自缔合形式中相似。为解释这一效应，采用了AlphaFold建模，揭示蛋白多聚体的形成诱导电荷重新分布，产生延伸的正电荷区域，从而增强对负电荷多阴离子（如肝素）的静电吸引。
